summary: Regression re-run of /app/backend/tests/test_voice_transcribe.py after the try/except retry-without-hint fix in /api/voice/transcribe. All 24 pytest cases PASSED (previously 15 pass / 9 fail). The 9 previously-failing Whisper-proxy-rejected codes (bn, te, gu, ml, pa, or, as, sa, sd) now return HTTP 200 via the silent retry fallback. The 7 already-accepted codes (en, hi, ta, mr, kn, ur, ne) still return 200 with no regression. Unsupported 'sat' + garbage 'xyzzy' still gracefully return 200 (auto-detect path). Empty audio still correctly returns 500 with 'Transcription failed' — retry path did not mask real errors. Missing auth still returns 401, missing file returns 422. Chat/stream smoke + RTI Rule 3 citation sanity tests also pass. Fix is verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in server.py:714-746 is correct — wraps only the Whisper API call in try/except, checks for 'unsupported_language' in error, and retries without the language kwarg. The outer try/except still catches genuine failures (e.g. empty audio) and returns 500 as expected.

The retry-fallback approach is preferable to hard-coding a narrower WHISPER_HINT_SET because if Emergent adds support for more languages later, the hint will start working automatically without a code change.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing /tmp/test_audio.m4a and /tmp/test_silence.m4a fixtures + protest@gandhikar.in / test1234.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice transcribe endpoint is fully verified for all 22 Indian language codes. If future iterations touch /api/voice/transcribe or WHISPER_HINT_SET, re-run backend/tests/test_voice_transcribe.py — it's the canonical regression guard for the mic flow.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original bug: Emergent's Whisper proxy silently rejects 9 of the 16 ISO 639-1 codes in server.py's WHISPER_HINT_SET (bn, te, gu, ml, pa, or, as, sa, sd) with HTTP 400 'unsupported_language'. The old code passed those hints through and let the exception bubble as HTTP 500 — every Bengali/Telugu/etc user experienced a silent mic failure. Fix: catch the BadRequestError, detect 'unsupported_language' in the message, and retry the Whisper call without the language kwarg (auto-detect). Verified: all 9 rejected codes now return HTTP 200; all 7 accepted codes still return 200; genuine audio errors still surface as 500.
